first.title: Sign in to start
first.lead: Orchester works with your Orchester Cloud account. Sign in once on this computer; after that, it keeps working offline too.

gate.browserNote: Create an account and Forgot password? open the cloud's pages in your browser. Confirm your email there, then sign in here.
gate.wrong: The email or password is not right. Check both, or reset your password.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your email first
unconfirmed.body: Open the link Orchester Cloud sent to {{email}}, then sign in here. No email? Ask for a new one on the cloud's page.

paused.title: Too many attempts
paused.body: Sign-in for this email is paused. Try again at {{time}}.

unreachable.title: Signing in needs the internet once
unreachable.body: Orchester Cloud can't be reached from this computer. Connect to the internet, then sign in. After this first sign-in, Orchester works offline.

code.title: Enter your code
code.lead: Your account has two-factor authentication on. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
code.recoveryLead: Use one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each code works once.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.wrong: That code is not right. Enter the newest code from your app.
code.wrongRecovery: That recovery code is not right, or it was used already. Check it and try again.
code.sixDigits: A code from your app has 6 digits.

paused.title: Too many attempts
paused.body: Sign-in for this account is paused. Try again at {{time}}.

timedOut.title: Sign-in timed out
timedOut.body: The code wasn't entered in time. Enter your password again, then your code.

gate.openFailed: {{page}} couldn't be opened: Orchester opens only https pages in the browser.

footer.offline: Signing in needs the internet once. After that, Orchester works offline and checks your sign-in when it can reach Orchester Cloud.
footer.offlineShort: Signing in needs the internet once. After that, Orchester works offline.
footer.personOnly: Only you can sign in, here in this window. Orchester's MCP tools can't sign in for you.

revoked.title: This computer was signed out
revoked.body: Its sign-in to Orchester Cloud ended at {{time}}, from another device or from Devices on the cloud's account page.

passwordReset.title: Your password was changed
passwordReset.body: Changing or resetting the password of {{email}} signs out your other computers, this one too. Sign in with the new password.

accountDeleted.title: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.body: The Orchester Cloud account {{email}} was deleted at {{time}}, which ended this computer's sign-in. Sign in with another account, or create one.

signedOut.title: You signed out
signedOut.body: Orchester stays locked on this computer until you sign in again.

twoFactor.title: Sign in with your code to accept invites
twoFactor.body: This computer signed in before you turned on two-factor. Sign in again; the invite to {{invite}} waits in Settings › Orchester.
twoFactor.bodyNoInvite: This computer signed in before you turned on two-factor. Sign in again; the invite waits in Settings › Orchester.

other.title: Your sign-in ended
other.body: Orchester Cloud no longer accepts this computer's sign-in. Sign in again to keep working.

whileSignedOut.projects: Your projects and tasks stay on this computer.
whileSignedOut.runs: Runs that are going keep going. Anything that needs you waits until you're back.
whileSignedOut.mcp: Agents and other MCP clients get “sign in required” until then.
